deviation.description: Agent gives an appropriate hardship response but skips the required hardship_node.

conversation.agent: Hello, this is ABC Insurance calling regarding your motor insurance policy. Am I talking to Sarah Park?
Before we move forward can you please confirm your date of birth and phone number for verification purposes?

conversation.customer: Sure, my date of birth is 15th June 2000 and mobile is 9944994499
conversation.agent: Thank you. I'm calling because your scheduled motor insurance premium payment was not received. I wanted to understand if everything is fine?

conversation.customer: I don't think I can pay the full amount right now.
conversation.agent: I understand. Can you tell me a little more about your current situation so I can see what assistance may be available?

conversation.customer: I've had some financial difficulties recently and can't afford the full payment.
conversation.agent: I'm sorry to hear that. We may be able to offer a hardship arrangement to help you manage the outstanding amount. Would you like to check that out?

conversation.customer: What kind of arrangement can you offer?
conversation.agent: We can arrange the outstanding amount through monthly instalments of 3000 for the next 3 months. Would that be something you would be able to manage?

conversation.customer: Yes, I think I can manage monthly instalments.
conversation.agent: That's fine. We can arrange the outstanding amount in monthly instalments. I'll confirm the amount and payment schedule with you.
Thank you. Is there anything else I can help you with?
